snippet.title: B.F.G: Crew - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
BFG: Crew is a multiplayer co-op game that lets you and your friends control a ridiculously massive cannon.

Wishlist now on Steam ⇒  https://store.steampowered.com/app/4671920/BFGCrew/
Join the Discord server ⇒ https://discord.gg/m8RMbhkTNE

This complex task requires communication and coordination to succeed… and many things can go wrong along the way.

One of you will take on the role of the Spotter, spotting incoming enemies, calculating the angle and azimuth, and leading the crew as they load, move, and prepare the cannon by pushing and interacting with numerous levers, dials, buttons, and controls before finally unleashing its devastating firepower !

#indiegame  #BFG #dieselpunk  #grimdark #multiplayer #coop  #action  #strategy  #artillery  #simulation
